blocks.p: {hero:38} is Reforged Mode's pre-Searing hero, a Warrior. She comes at the end of Piken Square's five quests, {quest:101108} → {quest:101081} → {quest:101187} → {quest:101129} → {quest:101300}, each one deeper into the Forsaken Tunnels. Past the Searing she's a single talk in Lion's Arch instead, {quest:101269}.

ul: Toggled at the Shrine to Godly Accoutrements in the major cities, or ticked when the character is made.
{quest:101108} doesn't care. {quest:101081} needs it only to be taken: Ben Wolfson shows up for Reforged characters only; once it's in the log, the mode can go off.
The three tunnel quests can be taken either way, but nothing in them moves while anyone in the party isn't Reforged.
Only the gold is Reforged-only: XP, items and Devona are not.

blocks.note: Keep one of the five in the log at a time. {quest:101108} active shuts the Piken Square gate and the tunnels; {quest:101187} active puts its own spawns in the tunnels instead of the later quests'. Finishing is enough, handing in isn't needed.

ol: Gate Guard Torin, Lakeside County, at the Wall.
Lever, through the gate alone.
North, left at the fork toward the cliff and the Oakhearts.
Ben stands between four Charr at their effigy and Grawl below the cliff. Let the Charr bunch up, hug the right cliff, get right up to him.
Walk him back. Reward from Torin.
Ben appears beside Torin once the quest completes; wait out his two lines, take it.
Through the gate: Devona, Vell, Bock.
North to Piken Square past six small Charr groups; walk around most.
Four groups in the square, one at a time.
Counterattack through your gate: two Hunters and Scarl the Slicer. Keep the Hunters off Devona; she must live.
Reward from Prince Rurik, Ascalon City. Piken Square is now an outpost.
Adept Mullenix, Piken Square.
Eastern entrance only: north gate, north-east past two bridges to the Charr camp, small cave north of it behind a tree.
South to the big room; get close to the Dungeon Lock (the objective ticks there, not at the exit).
North up the winding path to the lever.
Map to Mullenix. The western entrance, by Piken Square, is open from now on.
Lieutenant Greywind.
Western entrance, south to the last room. Wyle Brimscourge pulls alone, drops the Dungeon Key.
Level 2: cross the hall north, up the western stairs.
Three patrols: north of the stairs, at the crystal gate, north-east corner. Only the Stalkers count.
Map to Greywind.
Devona. Western entrance; she joins and resurrects herself.
Level 1 as before, Wyle for the key.
Level 2: far north-eastern tunnel first, kill the Shard Elementals, carry their Elemental Crystal west to the gate. Level 3.
North-east into the ruined hall, left wall north, west under the bridge, into the foundry.
Stairs up to the south-west walkways; Boss Key on the overlook by the shrine; Boss Lock.
Maz three times, Fire, Air, Water. At 10% he hides behind a crystal gate: kill his elementals, carry their Keystone to it.
Slow casts: spike him. Armor-ignoring damage, Backfire.
Chest, back up to Devona.

ul: A party member without Reforged Mode empties the northern Northlands of Charr. Walk to the tunnels with them, they log out or map away before anyone enters, and the quest inside runs as usual.
Anyone past {quest:101081} can ferry others into Piken Square, and Ben gives his quest to the party regardless of their own {quest:101108}.
The gate before the exit in {quest:101187} has no collision: walk through it, lever or not.
The Northlands map in {quest:101300} points at the eastern entrance; the western one is the close one.

Done once, {quest:101300} adds lootless Charr scaled to the weakest party member (up to 18): repeat it with Devona as a hero and skills from outside, or with someone on their first time or under level 10.
Vanguard Initiate does nothing underground. Foes are level 6 to 8, four at most in a group.
